sinopsis.es: En 2075, Iris, una niña de diez años, ve caer del cielo a un niño misterioso con un traje arcoíris. Es Arco. Iris lo acoge y lo ayuda a regresar a casa por cualquier medio posible.
sinopsis.en: Ten-year-old Arco lives in a far future. During his first flight in his rainbow suit, he loses control and falls into the past. Iris, a girl his age from 2075, comes to his rescue and tries by any means to help send him back to his own era.
